description.en: Louisiana is a state in the Deep South and South Central regions of the United States. It is bordered by Texas to the west, Arkansas to the north, and Mississippi to the east.
description.zh-CN: 路易斯安那州，簡稱路州，是美國的一個州，位於墨西哥灣沿岸。此州以對比強烈的文化、地理景觀著名。
